goal: Prevent inbound Tor peers from misclassifying by IP and gaining unintended local whitelist permissions
Ensure nodes running automatic Tor alongside explicit bind options use dedicated listeners
agreement: Contested objection that failing startup breaks existing common single-bind node configurations (sedited)
Suggestion to only refuse startup if a whitelist is configured alongside custom binds (hodlinator)
Support for rejecting shared binds rather than adding complex fallback options (vasild)
Verified by building and testing on FreeBSD (winterrdog)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it fixes an inbound permission bypass risk where Tor peers can inherit IP whitelist permissions
It protects node operators who run automatic Tor services alongside explicit network binds
